plain_description: **Help developers complete and generate code from surrounding context.** Trained across 600+ programming languages, it can suggest code snippets and support code generation.
technical_description: StarCoder2-15B is a 15-billion-parameter text generation model trained on more than 4 trillion tokens from The Stack v2 and other selected sources. It uses a fill-in-the-middle objective and supports a 16,384-token context window. The README shows loading it with Transformers on CPU or GPU and describes 8-bit and 4-bit quantization through bitsandbytes. It is not an instruction model, and generated code may contain bugs or exploits.
title: StarCoder2
